identityConflict.disposition: Stale/misconfigured metadata; rejected because the CP catalog launch mapping, game title art and game-specific bundle identify Club Goddess.

transport.serialization: HttpRequest.formatParams concatenates key=value pairs with '&' and does not call encodeURIComponent; object/array values use JSON.stringify.
transport.genericBinaryProtocolDisposition: src/assets/Common/Lib/protocol.060d7.js is a generic package/message codec and was not used by any observed Club Goddess HTTP gameplay request.

canonicalization: Take the original request object before signapt and expire exist.
Sort Object.keys(request) with JavaScript default lexicographic sort.
Render scalar as key=value; render object/array as key=JSON.stringify(value).
requestSigning.appendOrder: formatParams assigns signapt first, expire second, then enumerates the mutated object for form output.

observedRequestOrder.purpose: Obtain game bet/configuration, server clock and resolved language.
Exchange launch token for authenticated session data and current balance.
Load promotional free-bet activity; captured activity list was empty and is not Scatter Free Spins.
Paid base result and, according to current-game code, each later Free Spin step through the same route.
Refresh aggregate History after the ten paid rounds.
Load selected-day order detail and its results[] steps.

responseContract.game_info.game_way[0].way_id: 206010000; opaque configuration identifier, not the 243 Ways count.
responseContract.initial_config.current_sys_time: Server epoch seconds used for signing clock adjustment.
responseContract.language: Server-resolved locale; capture resolved pt-br request to en-us.

endpoints.responseContract: data has the same result shape as gameResult. The captured oid was '0', end_gold equaled authenticated balance, and no paid Round is indexed from this first-load snapshot.
data.list contains day, bet_gold, change_gold; data.statistics contains total_bet_gold and total_change_gold.
data.list contains paid orders; each order has results[] for its adjacent result steps. Ordinary captured orders have exactly one mirrored result step.

winModel.waysFormula: Multiply matching position counts on each consecutive reel starting with reel 1.

stateMachine.roundIdentity: A real paid Round begins only on a user-authorized type=1 gameResult response with nonzero oid. initRoom oid='0' first-load snapshot is not a paid Round.
stateMachine.deliveryIdentity: The live response has no explicit deliveryId or stepId. History results[] is the only current-game evidence of multiple adjacent steps under one paid order.

ordinaryPaidTransition.precondition: IDLE or AUTO_IDLE, authenticated, accepted bet selection and sufficient balance.
ordinaryPaidTransition.request: POST /single_game.Game/gameResult with act_id='0' for normal paid play.
ordinaryPaidTransition.response: type=1; debit bet_gold; evaluate props; credit total_win.
ordinaryPaidTransition.terminalWhen: frees.st == 0. This covers captured ordinary LOSS and WIN.
ordinaryPaidTransition.nextWhenSpecial: frees.st > 0 enters Free Spins; saved complete sequences confirm the next response is type=2.

freeSpinTransition.requestBoundary: Before each free request, frontend locally decrements the prior frees.st and calls the same gameResult route with the same bet-size/level shape.
freeSpinTransition.retriggerRuleFromCode: new frees.st > locally decremented oldFreeTimes means additional spins were awarded.
freeSpinTransition.terminationRuleFromCode: new frees.st == 0 exits Free mode and displays frees.twa.
freeSpinTransition.multiplierRule: Starts x2; collect Wilds; every 3 increases multiplier by 2 and resets collection progress; maximum x20.

resumeTransition.rule: Client installs the returned gameResult-shaped data. It can render type=1 base snapshot or use type/frees fields to present an active/completed Free mode.
resumeTransition.captured: Only a type=1 oid='0' snapshot was captured.

recoveryTransition.rule: On gameResult failure, wait up to the five-second retry interval then call initRoom; if returned oid equals current oid, wait to the one-second same-result interval and retry gameResult; a changed oid is accepted as the result.
recoveryTransition.sequenceGuard: A module sequence number invalidates callbacks from older requests.

historyContract.ordinaryOrder: order_id = oid + '-2060'; results.length=1; results[0] mirrors the result payload and is terminal.
historyContract.specialOrder: One paid order groups the type=1 trigger and every adjacent type=2 step; preserved complete 12/15-spin chains confirm terminal frees.st=0.

unknownAndForbiddenInferences: Scatter or Wild own cash pays
30 as paylineCount (it is a base-bet factor; paylines are not applicable)

redisSourceContract.member: compact ASCII CG2 complete-round minimal fact

runtimeSourcePolicy: Captured responses and fixtures are oracle-only. Runtime gameResult must project the single Redis member claimed at paid start; runtime generation and fixture fallback are forbidden.

generationModel.method: joint special-count signature and conditional three-cell columns by paid/free entry
